name: my-taste
description: A local-first contextual preference layer that learns explicit writing, UI, and video taste and applies it when relevant.

interface.shortDescription: Learn and apply your creative preferences.
interface.longDescription: Save explicit style references from writing, websites, screenshots, and video, then retrieve the right preferences automatically for future creative tasks.
defaultPrompt: I like this website screenshot. Analyze its design style and save it to My Taste.
Use my saved UI taste when creating this landing page.
I like how this Reel is edited. Save its video style.
